programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska is going to Austria.There he meets an extraordinary gymnast, Jennifer Bricker-Bauer, who... was born without legs.Shortly after being born, she was abandoned in the hospital.Her adoptive parents gave her a great will to fight and also taught her not to use words such as "I can't", "I can't do it" or "I can't".She reached for the dreams that were within her reach and achieved success.Now he infects others with his optimism and motivates them.The story of the heroine of the third episode is a great example that the best scripts are written by life, and insurmountable barriers simply do not exist.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: There are still places where education remains a luxury that many children can only dream of.These include Bangladesh - a small country in South Asia, one of the most densely populated and poorest in the world.An area twice as small as Poland is inhabited by as many as 170 million people.At the same time, 20% of the population lives below the poverty line.Obtaining an education gives you a chance to improve your financial situation.Unfortunately, the monsoons that hit Bangladesh every year cut off 1/4 of its area from the rest of the world, including schools.To help thousands of children, squares, libraries and educational centers were created... on boats.He studies there, among others:Rabija, the youngest heroine of Martyna Wojciechowska's program so far.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska goes to Prague, Czech Republic, where she plans to talk about... sex.The heroine of the episode is Vladana Augsten, a professional who treats sexuality through touch.She is a certified sexual assistant for disabled people, one of eleven in the Czech Republic.In Switzerland, Belgium, the Netherlands and Germany, this profession is widely known, but in this post-communist country it appeared for the first time only five years ago.Organizations training people involved in it also received funding from the state.One of them is the Freya Foundation.The sexuality of disabled people remains a taboo.Parents not only avoid the topic, but even make it difficult for their children to establish closer relationships, wanting to spare them pain and disappointment.The goal of Vladana and other sexual assistants is to support clients in their pursuit of independence.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Malta is a small but picturesque island country located in the Mediterranean Sea.Every year, makeshift boats and rafts come to its shores, bringing over three thousand refugees fleeing war, hunger and human trafficking.Only the strongest survive the journey in terrible conditions.Then they have to drift for up to forty days along the sea border because no one wants to accept them.Martyna Wojciechowska meets Hermon from war-torn Eritrea, and Agnes from Zimbabwe.The former did not intend to come to Europe, but when she became pregnant, she had no choice - this was the only way to ensure the safety of herself and her daughter.The second was a victim of human trafficking.She hasn't seen her children for five years.She works hard to become independent and create a new home for her family.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: This is the unique, 100th edition of the program whose main character is Elżbieta Dzikowska.She is a sinologist, journalist, art historian and photographer, but she is most famous as a traveler.Together with Tony Halik, she discovered the farthest, wildest corners of the Earth for Poles at a time when they practically could not cross the border of their country.It was she who made Martyna Wojciechowska, who was just a few years old, start dreaming about expeditions.Many years later, the women met and became friends, but so far they have not had the opportunity to go on a journey together.Now the situation has changed, and the destination of the escapade is Podlasie.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Saudi Arabia is one of the few absolute monarchies in the world where Muslim Sharia law still applies.Raha Moharrak was born there - she had enough courage and determination to break the prevailing patterns, thanks to which she was able to fulfill her dreams and conquer the Crown of the Earth, the highest peaks of seven continents.The heroine of the episode achieved this as the first woman from Saudi Arabia.In a country where her gender gained voting rights only in 2011, and in 2018 they were allowed to drive a car or travel abroad without the consent of a male guardian.The biggest problem for Raha was getting her father's consent to participate in the Kilimanjaro expedition, because according to Sharia law, a daughter must obey her parent, and he was against her idea, as was traditional society.However, the girl did not give up.When she conquered Mount Everest, she became a national media star.She continues to inspire other women.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Malawi is a small East African country.Martyna Wojciechowska visits Theresa Kachindamoto, who lives and works in the Dedza district.She is called the Terminator by the inhabitants of the country.She was born into a tribal royal family, the youngest of thirteen siblings.When her eldest brother died, the rest of her siblings elected her as the leader of the almost million-strong community.Never before has a woman performed such an important function.Thanks to her rule, Theresa gained fame and notoriety.During the dozen or so years she was in power, she opposed the customs of the time, annulling over five thousand marriages of underage girls.However, the activities of the heroine of the episode are appreciated not only in her country.At the White House, she received the Local Community Leader award from Michelle Obama and Hillary Clinton.Thanks to Chief Kachindamoto, thousands of underage women were able to return to school - previously 40% of them were married off before they turned 18.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: In Georgia, there is a clear division into female and male roles.Women have to take care of the house and give birth to children, while men work.In the Caucasus, family is the most valuable, infertility is a taboo topic.Mariam Kukunashvili helps couples, including homosexuals, who want to have children but are struggling with difficulties.She created a network of clinics, and today she is one of the most influential and richest women in the country.She was inspired by her own story - to become a mother, she underwent many years of treatment, struggled with difficult experiences, and finally used the help of surrogates.Patients can benefit from in vitro treatment, the services of surrogate mothers or an egg bank.Similar practices are a controversial topic in Georgia, especially among women.Mariam Kukunashvili breaks stereotypes in the context of traditional society.Its activities have expanded to other parts of the world, including:Ukraine, South Africa, Mexico and Kenya.Thanks to this, 7,000 children from 70 countries have already been born.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Kenya, located in East Africa, is inhabited by 55 million people, over 40 different tribes who speak almost 70 languages ​​in total.Although there is a real mosaic of cultures and beliefs there, not everyone is accepted, and being different can even cost your life.Martyna Wojciechowska visits this republic to meet Darlan.She claims to be the first outed intersex person in her country.Today, he is popular, sings, records music videos, designs clothes, and preaches tolerance.However, this was not always the case.A child born with sexual organs different from those typical of a boy or girl may be considered a curse on the community and killed.Darlan's childhood was marked by humiliation, sarcastic remarks, but also attacks and loneliness.Currently he is fighting for "others".The Darlan Rukih Church is one of the 4,000 officially registered in Kenya and has half a million believers.He cares for all those who are rejected.
